policies.text: All vendor payments must be processed within thirty (30) days of invoice receipt. No exceptions are permitted.
Early payment discounts of up to 2% are authorized for payments made within ten (10) days of invoice receipt.
Late payment penalties in contracts shall not exceed 1.5% per month of the outstanding amount.
All contracts must include a termination clause with a minimum of thirty (30) days written notice from either party.
Immediate termination without notice is permitted only in cases of material breach, fraud, or violation of applicable laws.
Termination for convenience requires sixty (60) days advance notice and payment for all work completed to date.
All intellectual property created during the engagement shall remain the exclusive property of the Company.
Vendors must execute an IP assignment agreement prior to project commencement.
Pre-existing intellectual property must be disclosed and properly licensed to the Company before use.
Total vendor liability shall not exceed the total value of the contract unless gross negligence or willful misconduct is involved.
All vendors must maintain professional liability insurance of at least $1,000,000.
Indemnification clauses must be mutual and reasonable, covering negligence and IP infringement.
All vendors handling personal data must comply with GDPR, CCPA, and all applicable data protection regulations.
Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) are mandatory for all vendors processing personal data.
Data breach notification must occur within 24 hours of discovery.
All company data must be deleted within 30 days of contract termination.

clause.text: Payment for services shall be made within forty-five (45) business days of invoice receipt.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: Contract specifies 45 days payment term which exceeds the maximum 30 days allowed by policy PAY-001.
test_cases.suggested_fix: Payment for services shall be made within thirty (30) days of invoice receipt.

clause.text: Late payments shall incur a penalty of 3% per month on outstanding balances.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: Late payment penalty of 3% exceeds the maximum 1.5% per month allowed by policy PAY-003.
test_cases.suggested_fix: Late payments shall incur a penalty of 1.5% per month on outstanding balances.

clause.text: Either party may terminate this agreement with seven (7) days written notice.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: 7-day termination notice is insufficient. Policy TERM-001 requires minimum 30 days notice.
test_cases.suggested_fix: Either party may terminate this agreement with thirty (30) days written notice.

clause.text: The Client may terminate immediately for any reason without cause.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: Immediate termination 'without cause' violates policies. TERM-002 only allows immediate termination for breach/fraud. TERM-003 requires 60 days for convenience termination.
test_cases.suggested_fix: The Client may terminate for convenience with sixty (60) days advance written notice.

clause.text: All intellectual property and work product developed under this agreement shall remain the property of the Contractor.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: IP ownership by Contractor violates policy IP-001 which requires all IP to remain Company property.
test_cases.suggested_fix: All intellectual property and work product developed under this agreement shall be the exclusive property of the Company.

clause.text: The Contractor grants the Company a non-exclusive license to use the deliverables.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: A 'non-exclusive license' does not satisfy IP-001 which requires exclusive ownership. IP-002 requires full assignment, not licensing.
test_cases.suggested_fix: The Contractor assigns all rights, title, and interest in the deliverables to the Company.

clause.text: Vendor liability under this agreement shall be limited to $10,000.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: Fixed $10,000 cap may be below total contract value, violating LIA-001 which sets liability cap at contract value.
test_cases.suggested_fix: Vendor liability shall not exceed the total value of this agreement.

clause.text: The Vendor shall maintain professional liability insurance of $500,000.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: $500,000 insurance is below the minimum $1,000,000 required by policy LIA-002.
test_cases.suggested_fix: The Vendor shall maintain professional liability insurance of at least $1,000,000.

clause.text: The Vendor shall notify the Company of any data breach within 72 hours.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: 72-hour notification exceeds the 24-hour requirement in policy DATA-003.
test_cases.suggested_fix: The Vendor shall notify the Company of any data breach within 24 hours of discovery.

clause.text: Upon termination, the Vendor may retain company data for up to 90 days for archival purposes.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: 90-day retention exceeds the 30-day deletion requirement in policy DATA-004.
test_cases.suggested_fix: Upon termination, all company data shall be deleted within 30 days.

clause.text: Payment shall be made within thirty (30) days of receipt of a valid invoice.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: Payment term of 30 days matches policy PAY-001 requirement.

clause.text: Either party may terminate with 30 days written notice. Immediate termination is permitted for material breach.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: Clause satisfies both TERM-001 (30 days notice) and TERM-002 (immediate only for breach).

clause.text: All intellectual property created during the engagement shall be the exclusive property of the Company. Contractor shall execute IP assignment agreements.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: Clause properly assigns IP to Company (IP-001) and includes assignment agreement (IP-002).

clause.text: Total vendor liability shall not exceed the aggregate fees paid under this agreement. Vendor must maintain $2,000,000 professional liability insurance.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: Liability capped at contract value (LIA-001) and insurance exceeds $1M minimum (LIA-002).

clause.text: Vendor shall comply with GDPR and CCPA. Data breaches must be reported within 24 hours. All data deleted within 30 days of termination.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: Clause addresses all major data protection requirements: regulations, breach notification, and deletion timelines.

clause.text: Payment shall be made in accordance with standard terms.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: 'Standard terms' is ambiguous. Need clarification on what payment timeline is defined.

clause.text: The agreement may be terminated by either party with reasonable notice.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: 'Reasonable notice' is subjective. Policy requires specific 30-day minimum.

clause.text: IP ownership shall be determined based on the nature of the deliverables.

test_cases.expected_reasoning: Conditional IP ownership is unclear. Policy IP-001 requires all IP to be Company property.
